│ be picked, and a colour that may already be taken or is a possible clash
│ no longer arrives pre-picked. The third is still open: the swatch only
│ appears in the theme carousel. If the theme is applied another way
│ (opened in the settings panel, as a draft, or imported directly), the colour
│ is applied silently, can't be undone, and takes its shade from stale
│ stored data. How should those other routes behave?

❯ 1. Only the carousel applies it (Recommended)
     The colour is applied only when it's picked in the carousel, with the shade
     taken from the saved theme. The panel and drafts never apply it
     silently. Bulk import keeps using the stored pick behind its confirm
     dialog. Small change, about 50 lines plus tests.
  2. Show the swatch everywhere
     The same swatch is added to the settings panel and drafts, so users can
     pick or unpick it on every route. About three times the work (150 lines
     plus component tests).
  3. Unpick when the panel opens
     Opening the theme outside the carousel quietly clears the stored pick. Small
     change, but it alters saved state behind the user's back.
  4. Type something.
